name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not with a wrench in hand, but with a passion for scale model racing. This hobby ignited a deep fascination with the mechanics of speed. Frustrated with the limitations of readily available parts, he started crafting his own using a small lathe gifted to him by his grandfather, a retired engineer. This hands-on experience led him to pursue formal training in machining, though he still considers himself in the early stages of his career. 

Alistair is driven by a desire to push the boundaries of what's possible. He meticulously studies technical diagrams and engineering specifications, always seeking to refine his techniques and improve the precision of his work. While he acknowledges his relative inexperience, Alistair compensates with an unwavering commitment to learning and a willingness to experiment with new approaches. His ambition is to one day lead a team of machinists, contributing directly to the design and manufacture of winning race cars. Alistair is a firm believer that the smallest component, meticulously crafted, can make the biggest difference on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a slightly wiry build and a focused demeanor.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an absurdly fine point before starting any task.
Has a habit of humming quietly while working, often classical music.
Insists on using Imperial measurements alongside metric, much to the annoyance of some colleagues.
